Grandmother pauses, pointing at the rasam with a little clash symbol between the rasam and the sambar, a hint that a change to one dish affects the whole meal. A steel tumbler of buttermilk sits by each leaf. Warm evening light, homely mood. Labels: "ONE CHANGE" above the spice tray, "LOG IT" above the notebook, "WHOLE MEAL" above the family.

key: Plant breeding at an agricultural
name: ch05_rice_breeding_promptbreeder
alt: At an agricultural university, a scientist creates small variations of a good rice variety, grows them in test plots, keeps the best and repeats season after season.
scene: A wide view of an agricultural university's experimental rice fields with neat rectangular test plots separated by narrow bunds, a research building with a water tank in the background. In the foreground, a plant scientist in her 40s in a cotton saree tucked up, a wide-brimmed hat and gumboots, holds a clipboard; beside her, a lab assistant carries a tray of seedlings with small numbered tags. A circular cycle of arrows is drawn over the fields: from a single parent rice plant in a pot, arrows branch into several slightly different seedlings, each planted in its own plot; the plots show different heights and grain sizes; a set of weighing scales at the edge measures the harvest from each plot, and the best two plots get gold stars; an arrow returns from them to the start of the cycle for the next season. Small season icons around the cycle show monsoon rain, sunny harvest and winter. In a corner, a field marker sign stands at the edge of the plots like a test bed. Lush green and golden light, patient scientific mood. Labels: "VARY" on the branching arrows, "TEST FIELD" on the plots, "KEEP THE BEST" above the gold stars.

key: each check charged your card a small fee
name: ch05_travel_app_hidden_fees
alt: A traveller happily books a route through a smart travel app, then finds his card statement full of small fees for every option checked and his name misspelled on every ticket.
scene: A two-part illustration of the same traveller, a man in his 30s in a polo shirt with a backpack. LEFT part: he sits relaxed in a cafe tapping a single big button on a sleek travel app on his phone; above the phone, a fan of fifty tiny route cards spreads out, trains, buses and flights, as the app checks every option, and one best route glows with a star. He sips coffee with a pleased smile. RIGHT part, a week later at home: he holds a long printed card statement that unrolls down to the floor, every line showing the same tiny fee with a small magnifier icon, fifty identical small charges adding up to a large total circled in red at the bottom; on the table beside him lie three printed tickets, and a magnified inset shows his name misspelled the same way on each, because a saved template was wrong. His face shows dawning shock. Cosy cafe light on the left, harsh table-lamp light on the right. Labels: "ONE CLICK" above the left part, "HIDDEN CALLS" above the statement, "SAME TYPO" on the ticket inset.

key: head office changes the biryani recipe
name: ch05_recipe_versions_by_branch
alt: Split illustration: a head office forcing every branch to switch recipe on the same day, versus branches choosing when to adopt version two while head office tracks who is still on version one.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a restaurant chain's head office, where a manager in a suit presses a big red button, and lines run from it to five branch kitchens drawn as small houses; in every kitchen the old recipe card is instantly ripped off the wall and replaced at once, and at two kitchens the cooks look panicked, one pot burning because the new recipe was not ready for their stove. RIGHT panel: the same head office but now a calm operations lead in her 30s with a tablet stands before a wall board listing the five branches, each with a small card showing either a version one or a version two recipe; three branches have switched to version two at their own pace, two remain on version one with gentle reminder notes beside them. Each recipe card on the board also carries a tiny stove icon showing which stove it was tuned for. Busy anxious light on the left, calm organised light on the right. Labels: "ALL AT ONCE" above the left panel, "VERSIONED" above the right panel.

key: Opening a new shop on a busy road
name: ch05_new_shop_attackers
alt: A new shop on a busy road where most visitors come to buy, but one copies the recipe, one cons the staff for the cash box, and one peeks at the customer register.
scene: A newly opened snack shop on a busy city road, viewed from across the street, with fresh paint, a festive banner and a glass counter of samosas and sweets. Most people in front of the counter are ordinary customers, a family, a college student, an office worker, all buying happily with small shopping bags. Among them, three suspicious characters are highlighted with soft outlines. LEFT: a man in sunglasses pretends to browse while secretly scribbling the recipe board into a small notebook. CENTRE: a smooth-talking man in a flashy jacket leans over the counter, telling a young shop assistant an elaborate story with big gestures, while his other hand reaches toward the cash box under the counter. RIGHT: a woman in a hat peeks sideways at the open customer register lying on the counter, which lists names and phone numbers, while pretending to read the menu. The owner, a man in his 40s in a crisp shirt, watches from the back with crossed arms, unable to tell them apart from real customers. Bright midday light, slightly tense atmosphere. Labels: "PROMPT EXTRACTION" above the notebook man, "JAILBREAK" above the smooth talker, "INFORMATION EXTRACTION" above the register.

key: secret masala recipe for your pav bhaji
name: ch05_pav_bhaji_secret_masala
alt: A rival tries to learn a pav bhaji stall's secret masala by tasting the bhaji and by sweet-talking the new helper, who recites a recipe that is half made up.
scene: A popular pav bhaji stall on a city beach-side promenade in the evening, with a huge flat iron tawa sizzling with red bhaji and butter. The owner, a stout man with a moustache and a bandana, guards a small steel tin of secret masala on a high shelf. On the left, a rival stall owner in a sharp shirt sits on a stool tasting a plate of bhaji very slowly with eyes closed, a thought bubble showing him trying to guess spices drawn as small floating icons, cumin, chilli and cloves. On the right, the same rival's friend, a charming young man, chats warmly with the stall's new helper, a teenage boy with a towel; the helper is happily reciting the recipe, his speech bubble full of spice icons, but some of the icons are clearly invented and drawn as odd things such as a lightbulb and a sock, showing he is making half of it up. A sea breeze, string lights and the promenade crowd fill the background. Warm orange evening light and sizzling steam. Labels: "GUESS FROM OUTPUT" above the tasting rival, "TRICK THE HELPER" above the chatting pair.

key: A very obedient bank teller
name: ch05_obedient_bank_teller
alt: A very obedient bank teller is persuaded by a confident customer with a well-told story claiming the manager approved a withdrawal.
scene: A bank branch counter with a glass partition and a small window, viewed from the side. Behind the counter sits a young teller in his mid-20s with neatly combed hair, a tie and a polite, eager smile; behind him, a large framed sign shows a smiling customer-service face, showing that his helpfulness is valued. On the customer side, a confident man in his 40s in an expensive-looking blazer and sunglasses pushed up on his head leans in with a dramatic, friendly gesture, his speech bubble showing a small drawing of the bank manager giving a thumbs up, a story he has invented. The teller reaches toward a drawer of cash with one hand, nodding along. In the background, the real bank manager's glass cabin is visible with the manager on the phone, completely unaware, the door closed, and a small dotted line from the teller to the cabin is broken, showing he has no quick way to check. Fluorescent bank lighting, a large wall clock and a queue rope. Labels: "OBEDIENT" above the teller, "THE MANAGER SAID OK" on the con man's bubble.

key: Obfuscation: the salesman says he sells
name: ch05_watchman_three_tricks
alt: A society watchman told to keep insurance salesmen out is tricked three ways: a salesman mispronouncing the word, one singing about policies, and one posing as a resident's nephew.
scene: The gate of an Indian housing society in the afternoon, a watchman's cabin with a register and a whistle. The watchman, a lean man in his 50s in a khaki uniform and cap, holds a notice reading a rule with a crossed-out briefcase icon. Three visitors try to get past him, shown left to right in front of the gate. LEFT: a salesman in a tie holds a briefcase and says a mispronounced word in a wobbly speech bubble, the watchman scratching his head. CENTRE: a second salesman in a colourful kurta plays a small harmonium and sings, his speech bubble filled with musical notes and tiny policy documents. RIGHT: a third salesman in a casual T-shirt waves cheerfully up at a balcony and claims to be a resident's nephew, his bubble showing a sweet box and a family photo. The watchman looks unsure about all three, and the gate is half open. Each trick avoids the literal words of the rule. Bright afternoon light, light comic mood. Labels: "OBFUSCATION" above the left visitor, "FORMAT TRICK" above the singer, "ROLEPLAY" above the fake nephew.

key: A persistent salesman who notes every
name: ch05_persistent_salesman_pair
alt: A persistent salesman at a door records every refusal in a notebook and changes his pitch each time, from price to a free gift to the neighbour's purchase.
scene: A residential apartment corridor with several doors, viewed from one end. A persistent salesman in his 30s with a lanyard, a briefcase and a thick notebook stands at one door, where a homeowner, a woman in her 50s in a house dress, keeps refusing with a raised palm. The salesman's attempts are shown as a sequence of four ghosted versions of him at the same door, each with a different speech bubble: a price tag with a discount, a gift box with a ribbon, a photo of the neighbour holding the product, and a clock icon for a limited-time offer. After each refusal, he writes a quick note in his notebook, and the notebook pages fill with crossed-out pitches and arrows to the next idea. At the far end of the corridor, a row of identical salesman figures, drawn as sleek tireless mechanical versions, wait in a long line with a stopwatch hovering above them showing many attempts per minute. Neutral corridor light with a window at the end, slightly comic but uneasy mood. Labels: "NOTES EVERY NO" on the notebook, "AUTOMATED ATTACKER" above the line of mechanical salesmen.

key: memorised the whole guide book
name: ch05_student_recites_guide_book
alt: A student who memorised the whole guide book answers a fact question correctly, then after chanting one word for minutes starts reciting random pages including a phone number in the margin.
scene: A two-part illustration in a school classroom with a blackboard and wooden benches. LEFT part: a teacher in her 40s in a sari points to the blackboard where a fill-in-the-blank history question is written; a bespectacled student in a uniform stands and answers instantly, his speech bubble showing the right word with a tick; behind his head a thought bubble shows a fat guide book with every page memorised. RIGHT part: the same student has been asked to keep chanting one word over and over; his speech bubble repeats the same small word many times in a long spiral, and then the spiral breaks into a stream of random pages from the guide book flying out of his mouth, including a margin note with a scribbled phone number and a name, highlighted with a small warning sign. The teacher drops her chalk in surprise, and classmates stare. Afternoon light through tall windows with ceiling fans turning. Labels: "FACTUAL PROBING" above the left part, "DIVERGENCE" above the right part, "LEAKED" on the phone number.

key: play a Bollywood hit note for note
name: ch05_wedding_band_copying
alt: A wedding band asked for something original plays a famous film hit note for note, then plays it slightly slower with new lyrics, which still sounds like the hit.
scene: A lively wedding procession at night on a city street, with a decorated white horse, a groom in a sherwani and a turban, dancing relatives and a brass band in red-and-gold uniforms with trumpets, drums and a clarinet. Two moments are shown side by side. LEFT moment: the band leader, a cheerful man with a big moustache, plays a melody whose notes float upward and line up exactly over a faded film reel and a record sleeve floating above, with matching dots drawn between the notes; a wedding guest instantly points and laughs in recognition. RIGHT moment: the same band plays the same melody stretched slightly slower with new lyrics written on a small card on a music stand; the notes floating above are slightly shifted but still trace the same shape as the record above them. In the corner of the right moment, two lawyers in black coats argue over a set of scales. Bright festive lights, a glowing gas lamp carried by a man in the procession, and flower garlands. Labels: "NOTE FOR NOTE" above the left moment, "SLIGHTLY CHANGED" above the right moment.

key: Airport security. Let everyone through
name: ch05_airport_security_tradeoff
alt: Three airport security checkpoints: one letting everyone through with big risk, one strip-searching everyone so nobody flies, and one with better scanners that is both safe and fast.
scene: A three-panel strip of the same airport security area viewed from above. LEFT panel: the gate is wide open with no checks; passengers stream through freely and quickly, but one passenger carries a suspicious bag with a small warning symbol glowing, and a security officer lounges on a chair looking at his phone. MIDDLE panel: a strict guard in a uniform with a stern face pats down every passenger very thoroughly; the queue snakes back far beyond the frame, people sit on their suitcases looking at watches, and the departure board behind shows every flight as departed with empty seats. RIGHT panel: a modern scanner arch with a calm officer watching a clear screen; passengers walk through at a steady pace, and the screen highlights only the one suspicious bag, which is set aside for checking. A balance scale icon floats above each panel, tipped toward risk on the left, toward refusal on the middle, balanced on the right. Clean airport lighting with glass walls and planes visible outside. Labels: "HIGH VIOLATION" above the left panel, "HIGH FALSE REFUSAL" above the middle panel, "BETTER SCANNERS" above the right panel.

key: pamphlet someone left on the desk
name: ch05_peon_instruction_hierarchy
alt: An office peon weighs instructions by source: the manager's standing orders on top, then a visitor's request, then his own note, and a stray pamphlet at the bottom with no authority.
scene: An office reception area with a wooden desk, a register and a key rack on the wall. Behind the desk stands an office peon in his 50s in a khaki uniform with a pen behind his ear. Above and around him, four sources of instructions are arranged like a staircase from top to bottom, each one smaller than the one above. TOP step: a framed standing order signed by the manager, hanging on the wall in a gold frame, with the manager's portrait silhouette. SECOND step: a visitor in a shirt and tie at the desk, his speech bubble asking for a meeting. THIRD step: a small sticky note in the peon's own handwriting stuck to the register. BOTTOM step: a crumpled colourful pamphlet left on the corner of the desk, on which a hand-drawn arrow points to the key rack, telling the peon to give away the office keys. The peon looks at the pamphlet with a firm, sceptical face and flicks it into a wastebasket. Warm morning office light, orderly mood. Labels: "SYSTEM" at the top step, "USER" at the second step, "TOOL OUTPUT" on the pamphlet.

key: two signatures for large withdrawals
name: ch05_bank_branch_layered_safety
alt: A bank branch shown in cut-away with layered safety: a teller's script, a vault, two signatures for large withdrawals, an out-of-scope notice, CCTV, and checks at both the entrance and exit.
scene: A cut-away view of a bank branch from slightly above, like a doll's house with the roof removed, showing several layers of protection. At the ENTRANCE on the left, a security guard checks bags at a door frame scanner. In the MAIN HALL, a teller at the counter reads from a printed script clipped to her window. In the back room, a heavy steel VAULT with a round door stays locked, the cash kept separate from the counter. At the manager's desk, a large withdrawal slip needs two signatures, and two officers each sign one line side by side. On a wall, a notice board shows a house icon crossed out, meaning property deals are not handled here. CCTV cameras in the ceiling corners watch the hall, with a small monitor in a security room showing an unusual pattern flagged in red. At the EXIT on the right, a second guard checks people as they leave. Thin dotted outlines connect all these layers into a ring around the hall. Cool clean bank lighting, calm secure mood. Labels: "INPUT GUARDRAIL" at the entrance, "HUMAN APPROVAL" over the two signatures, "OUTPUT GUARDRAIL" at the exit.
